==========================================================
 Prit Saileshbhai Joshi
 Versus
 State Of Gujarat

= = =
 Appearance:
 Mr. Kalrav R Patel(7041) for the Applicant(s) No. 1
 Ms. Nili K Patel(7043) for the Applicant(s) No. 1
 Mr Pruthvirajsinh D Parmar(9934) for the Respondent(s) No. 1
 Parth J Adhyaru(9359) for the Respondent(s) No. 1
 Mr. Chintan Dave, App for the Respondent(s) No. 1
 Siddhi V Vadodariya(9533) for the Respondent(s) No. 1
 ==========================================================
 Coram:Honourable Mr. Justice M. R. Mengdey
 Date : 11/12/2024
 Oral Order

1. By way of the present application under Section 482 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita,
2023, the Applicant has prayed for enlarging the Applicant on anticipatory bail in connection with the F I R be i ng C. R. No . 11190002241132 of 2024 registered wit h Botad Police Station, Botad for the offe nce s puni sha bl e unde r S ec tions 4 0 6 a n d 420 of the Indian Penal Code.

2. Heard learned Advocate for the Applicant and learned APP for the Respondent - State.
3.

Learned APP has drawn the attention of this Court to the aspect that despite issuance of notice to the present Applicant under Section 35(1)(b) of the Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, the Applicant has chosen not to remain present before the Investigating Officer.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 NEUTRAL CITATION R/CR.MA/20247/2024 ORDER DATED: 11/12/2024 undefined 4.
On the aforesaid statement made by the learned APP, the learned Advocate appearing for the Applicant submits that the Applicant shall remain present before the Investigation Officer on 16.12.2024.

5. Upon the statement being made at the bar by the learned Advocate for the Applicant, the Applicant, shall remain present before the Investigation Officer on 16.12.2024, and, after recording the statement of the Applicant, if the Investigation officer is desirous of arresting the Applicant,
seven day's prior notice shall be given to the Applicant prior to his arrest.
6.
The Application stands disposed of with the observation as aforesaid.
